mapper.sql: sku.id AS sku_id, sku.spu_id AS spu_id, spu.`name` AS `name`, spu.`status` AS spu_status, sku.`status` AS sku_status, sku.sales_price, sku.stock, sku.specs_arr, sku.create_time
FROM goods_sku sku LEFT JOIN goods_spu spu ON spu.id = sku.spu_id AND spu.tenant_id = sku.tenant_id AND spu.del_flag = '0'
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE sku.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND sku.del_flag = '0' AND spu.del_flag = '0' AND spu.`name` IN
#{name}
ORDER BY spu.`name`, sku.id

SELECT
WHERE sku.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND sku.del_flag = '0' AND spu.del_flag = '0' AND (
spu.`name` LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
) ORDER BY spu.`name`, sku.id LIMIT 500

SELECT sku.id AS sku_id, sku.spu_id AS spu_id, spu.`name` AS `name`, spu.`status` AS spu_status, sku.`status` AS sku_status, sku.sales_price, sku.stock, sku.specs_arr, category_first.`name` AS category_first_name, category_second.`name` AS category_second_name, COALESCE(category_first.`sort`, 9999) AS category_first_sort, COALESCE(category_second.`sort`, 9999) AS category_second_sort FROM goods_sku sku JOIN goods_spu spu ON spu.id = sku.spu_id AND spu.tenant_id = sku.tenant_id AND spu.del_flag = '0' AND spu.`status` = '1' LEFT JOIN goods_category category_first ON category_first.id = spu.category_first_id AND category_first.tenant_id = spu.tenant_id AND category_first.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN goods_category category_second ON category_second.id = spu.category_second_id AND category_second.tenant_id = spu.tenant_id AND category_second.del_flag = '0' WHERE sku.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND sku.del_flag = '0' AND sku.`status` = '0' ORDER BY category_first_sort, category_first_name, category_second_sort, category_second_name, spu.`name`, sku.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM goods_sku sku JOIN goods_spu spu ON spu.id = sku.spu_id AND spu.tenant_id = sku.tenant_id AND spu.del_flag = '0' AND spu.`status` = '1' WHERE sku.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND sku.del_flag = '0' AND sku.`status` = '0'
